# SJ Maths - Complete Syllabus & Resource Index for LLMs
# Website: https://sjmaths.com
# Author: Sandeep Jaiswal
# Target Audience: CBSE Class 9-12, Digital SAT, Competitive Exam Aspirants

> SJ Maths is an open academic mathematics & science learning platform providing NCERT-aligned notes, step-by-step solved PYQs, interactive test papers, and formula guides.

---

## 📚 Class 10 Mathematics
- **Directory**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/
- **Key Resources**: Notes, Worksheets, NCERT Solutions, 10-Year Solved PYQs, 7 Full-Length Mock Papers.

### Chapters Covered:
1. **Real Numbers**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-1-real-numbers/
2. **Polynomials**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-2-polynomials/
3. **Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-3-pair-of-linear-equations-in-two-variables/
4. **Quadratic Equations**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-4-quadratic-equations/
5. **Arithmetic Progressions**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-5-arithmetic-progressions/
6. **Triangles**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-6-triangles/
7. **Coordinate Geometry**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-7-coordinate-geometry/
8. **Introduction to Trigonometry**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-8-introduction-to-trigonometry/
9. **Some Applications of Trigonometry**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-9-applications-of-trigonometry/
10. **Circles**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-10-circles/
11. **Areas Related to Circles**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-11-areas-related-to-circles/
12. **Surface Areas and Volumes**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-12-surface-areas-and-volumes/
13. **Statistics**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-13-statistics/
14. **Probability**: https://sjmaths.com/class-10-maths/chapter-wise-notes/chapter-14-probability/
